requested_outcome: The VII admin dashboard greeting must match the current time in Israel, including at 15:00, and the corrected behavior must be verified on the exact published release.
authorization_boundary: Repair, test, commit, publish and verify the reported VII admin defect. Preserve unrelated work, data, credentials, domains and schedules.

lesson_bundle.reason: The visible correction must be translated into exact time boundaries and production evidence before implementation.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires a validated preflight, affected-family inventory, midpoint and exact natural-destination proof.

lesson_bundle.reason: A local source edit is insufficient for a production admin defect.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires focused regression, build evidence and live verification of the exact release.

lesson_bundle.reason: The change affects visible Hebrew text in the administration system.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires approved modern Hebrew typography to remain intact with no serif fallback.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The dashboard still says morning at 15:00.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Replace the hardcoded label with an Israel-time greeting function and cover 15:00 explicitly.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A test for 15:00 Asia/Jerusalem returns צהריים טובים and the published dashboard displays it.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The fix depends on the hosting server or browser timezone and fails during daylight-saving changes.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Read the hour through Intl.DateTimeFormat with the explicit Asia/Jerusalem timezone.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Winter and summer UTC instants map to the correct Israel greeting.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the single reported hour works while boundary hours are wrong.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Define and test morning, afternoon, evening and night boundaries.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Boundary tests pass for 05:00, 12:00, 17:00 and 21:00 Israel time.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The code is fixed locally but the old production release remains visible.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Publish one traceable release and reopen the authenticated production dashboard.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The exact production release shows the correct greeting after reload on desktop and mobile.

sources.label: Reported production screenshot showing the incorrect 15:00 greeting
VII accepted product and release behavior

midpoint_gate.trigger: The focused greeting tests pass before the full build and publication.
checks: summer and winter UTC instants use Israel local time
the dashboard no longer contains a hardcoded morning greeting

attack_questions: Can a UTC-hosted render still select the wrong greeting?
Does the greeting remain correct on both sides of every boundary?
Does a production reload show the corrected text rather than a cached prior build?
Did the Hebrew font or responsive heading regress?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Authenticated live inspection of https://vii.spaplus.co/admin on the exact new release.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests, full build and desktop/mobile live checks of the dashboard heading and typography.

effectiveness.baseline: Production release 427 always renders בוקר טוב for a named administrator because the text is hardcoded.
effectiveness.target: One causal implementation covers every Israel-time period and is visible on the first published release without another correction.
